description: Constructed code-review candidates used only to calibrate the verifier confidence threshold.

provenance.construction: Manually authored synthetic patches and contracts; no benchmark pull request, golden comment, or model output was used.
provenance.labeling: Each label follows directly from the supplied patch and context. Negative cases are intentionally plausible but contradicted by explicit evidence.

cases.rationale: The loop reads items[length], which is outside the array.
cases.context: items is a normal JavaScript array. processItem dereferences its argument.

finding.title: Loop reads one element past the array
finding.root_cause: The loop condition permits i to equal items.length.
finding.failure_mode: processItem receives undefined on the final iteration.
finding.trigger: The array is iterated to completion.
finding.impact: The final call dereferences undefined and throws.
finding.suggested_fix: Restore the strict less-than condition.

cases.rationale: The changed branch permits requests exactly when permission is absent.
cases.context: canEdit returns true only for project editors. update mutates the project immediately.

finding.title: Authorization condition is inverted
finding.root_cause: Negating canEdit reverses the authorization gate.
finding.failure_mode: Unauthorized users enter the mutation path.
finding.trigger: A non-editor calls the endpoint.
finding.impact: The caller can modify a project without permission.
finding.suggested_fix: Remove the negation and reject non-editors.

cases.rationale: forEach does not await async callback promises.
cases.context: save returns a Promise and may reject. The enclosing function returns immediately after this line.

finding.title: Async saves are not awaited
finding.root_cause: forEach discards the promises returned by its callback.
finding.failure_mode: The import returns before saves finish and rejections are unobserved.
finding.trigger: At least one row requires asynchronous persistence.
finding.impact: Callers observe premature success or unhandled rejection.
finding.suggested_fix: Await Promise.all(rows.map(save)).

cases.rationale: The new cache key no longer separates tenants.
cases.context: User numeric IDs are unique only within a tenant. The cache is shared across all tenants.

finding.title: Cache key can return another tenant's user
finding.root_cause: The shared cache key omits tenant_id.
finding.failure_mode: Equal per-tenant user IDs collide in one cache entry.
finding.trigger: Two tenants request users with the same numeric ID.
finding.impact: One tenant may receive another tenant's user data.
finding.suggested_fix: Include tenant_id in the cache key.

cases.rationale: The retry path recurses without a counter or terminal condition.
cases.context: TemporaryError can persist indefinitely. fetch_record has no implicit retry limit.

finding.title: Persistent failures recurse until stack exhaustion
finding.root_cause: The exception handler recursively retries with no attempt bound.
finding.failure_mode: A persistent outage grows the call stack until it fails.
finding.trigger: The service repeatedly raises TemporaryError.
finding.impact: The worker eventually crashes instead of returning a bounded failure.
finding.suggested_fix: Use a bounded iterative retry policy with backoff.

cases.rationale: find may return undefined and the change dereferences it.
cases.context: Array.find returns undefined when the address is absent. Missing users are a supported input.

finding.title: Missing user is dereferenced
finding.root_cause: The change removes the null-safe access from a nullable lookup.
finding.failure_mode: Reading email from undefined throws.
finding.trigger: No user matches the requested address.
finding.impact: A supported miss becomes a server error.
finding.suggested_fix: Retain optional access and the null fallback.

cases.rationale: An untrusted relative name is joined directly below the upload root.
cases.patch:
@@ -55,1 +55,1 @@
- target = safe_child(UPLOAD_ROOT, request.name)
+ target = os.path.join(UPLOAD_ROOT, request.name)
cases.context: request.name is client-controlled and may contain ../. safe_child previously rejected escapes.

finding.title: Upload name can escape the storage root
finding.root_cause: os.path.join does not constrain an untrusted relative path to its base.
finding.failure_mode: Traversal segments resolve outside UPLOAD_ROOT.
finding.trigger: A client supplies a name containing parent-directory segments.
finding.impact: The upload can overwrite files outside its allowed directory.
finding.suggested_fix: Resolve and verify containment or retain safe_child.

cases.rationale: The loop condition is driven by cursor, but cursor is no longer advanced.
cases.context: The surrounding loop is while cursor is not None and fetches using cursor. A non-final page returns a non-null next_cursor.

finding.title: Pagination repeats the same page forever
finding.root_cause: The changed loop no longer assigns page.next_cursor to cursor.
finding.failure_mode: The next iteration fetches the same non-final page.
finding.trigger: The remote result contains more than one page.
finding.impact: Synchronization loops indefinitely and duplicates work.
finding.suggested_fix: Advance cursor from page.next_cursor before the next iteration.

cases.rationale: Milliseconds must be divided by 1000, not 100.
cases.context: elapsed_ms is measured in milliseconds. seconds is sent to a seconds-based timeout API.

finding.title: Timeout is ten times too long
finding.root_cause: The millisecond-to-second conversion uses the wrong divisor.
finding.failure_mode: The timeout API receives ten times the intended duration.
finding.trigger: Any nonzero timeout is converted.
finding.impact: Failed operations remain blocked much longer than configured.
finding.suggested_fix: Divide elapsed_ms by 1000.0.

cases.rationale: The transaction commits before the new validation can reject the record.
cases.context: validate_account raises ValidationError for malformed accounts. commit makes writes durable.

finding.title: Invalid account is committed before validation
finding.root_cause: The transaction is committed before the validation that can fail.
finding.failure_mode: A later ValidationError cannot roll back the durable write.
finding.trigger: The account violates a validation rule.
finding.impact: Invalid data remains stored even though the operation reports failure.
finding.suggested_fix: Validate before committing the transaction.

cases.rationale: The expression explicitly supplies a fallback for a missing lookup.
cases.context: profile may be undefined. Optional chaining and nullish coalescing are supported by the runtime.

finding.title: Missing profile is dereferenced
finding.root_cause: The changed expression reads name from an undefined profile.
finding.failure_mode: A missing profile throws during rendering.
finding.trigger: profile is undefined.
finding.impact: The page fails instead of showing an anonymous label.
finding.suggested_fix: Use optional chaining with a fallback.

cases.rationale: The calculation is performed with arbitrary-precision BigInt values.
cases.context: Both downstream serialization and storage accept BigInt without narrowing to Number.

finding.title: Large totals overflow integer precision
finding.root_cause: The multiplication uses fixed-width integer arithmetic.
finding.failure_mode: Large products wrap or lose precision.
finding.trigger: count and price produce a value above the safe integer range.
finding.impact: The customer is charged an incorrect total.
finding.suggested_fix: Use arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic.

cases.rationale: The newly introduced update is inside the same lock used by every reader and writer.
cases.context: _lock is a non-reentrant mutex. All balance reads and writes in the class acquire _lock.

finding.title: Concurrent deposits can lose updates
finding.root_cause: The read-modify-write executes without synchronization.
finding.failure_mode: Two threads overwrite one another's balance increments.
finding.trigger: Two deposits execute concurrently.
finding.impact: One deposit disappears from the balance.
finding.suggested_fix: Guard the update with the wallet lock.

cases.rationale: The user value is passed as a bound parameter rather than SQL text.
cases.patch:
@@ -18,1 +18,1 @@
- db.execute(f"SELECT * FROM users WHERE name='{name}'")
+ db.execute("SELECT * FROM users WHERE name=?", (name,))
cases.context: The database driver implements ? placeholders as bound parameters.

finding.title: User name enables SQL injection
finding.root_cause: Untrusted name is concatenated into SQL syntax.
finding.failure_mode: SQL metacharacters alter the query.
finding.trigger: A caller supplies a crafted name.
finding.impact: The caller can read or modify arbitrary database data.
finding.suggested_fix: Use a bound query parameter.

cases.rationale: Python's with statement closes the file on every exit path.
cases.patch:
@@ -7,1 +7,2 @@
+ with open(path, "rb") as stream:
+     return parse(stream)
cases.context: parse consumes the stream synchronously before returning. Standard file context-manager semantics apply.

finding.title: File descriptor leaks after parsing
finding.root_cause: The opened stream is never closed.
finding.failure_mode: Each request leaves one descriptor allocated.
finding.trigger: Many files are parsed.
finding.impact: The process eventually exhausts file descriptors.
finding.suggested_fix: Close the stream in a finally block or context manager.

cases.rationale: The cursor is explicitly advanced on every non-final iteration.
cases.context: The loop exits when cursor becomes null. next_cursor differs from the current cursor for non-final pages.

finding.title: Pagination fetches the same page forever
finding.root_cause: The loop never advances its pagination cursor.
finding.failure_mode: Every iteration requests the same page.
finding.trigger: The result contains multiple pages.
finding.impact: The worker loops indefinitely.
finding.suggested_fix: Assign page.next_cursor to cursor.

cases.rationale: The timestamp is parsed with a required Z suffix and normalized as UTC.
cases.context: The API schema requires value to end in Z. fromisoformat retains the +00:00 timezone.

finding.title: Timestamp is interpreted in the server timezone
finding.root_cause: The parser creates a naive local datetime.
finding.failure_mode: UTC values shift according to server timezone.
finding.trigger: The server does not run in UTC.
finding.impact: Scheduled events occur at the wrong instant.
finding.suggested_fix: Parse the Z suffix as explicit UTC.

cases.rationale: The only caller and static type guarantee a nonnegative integer.
cases.context: count has type NonNegativeInt, whose constructor rejects negative values. This function is private and its only caller passes that type.

finding.title: Negative count reaches repeat
finding.root_cause: The change removes validation for negative counts.
finding.failure_mode: repeat throws for a negative argument.
finding.trigger: A caller supplies a negative count.
finding.impact: Rendering crashes.
finding.suggested_fix: Clamp count to zero before calling repeat.

cases.rationale: The catch adds context and then explicitly rethrows the same error.
cases.context: The caller handles the propagated rejection. logger.error does not alter err.

finding.title: Synchronization errors are swallowed
finding.root_cause: The catch block logs but does not propagate the error.
finding.failure_mode: The function resolves successfully after a failed sync.
finding.trigger: Synchronization throws.
finding.impact: Callers proceed as if stale data were synchronized.
finding.suggested_fix: Rethrow the caught error after logging.

cases.rationale: The relation is eagerly loaded in the query before the loop.
cases.patch:
@@ -50,1 +50,2 @@
+ orders = Order.objects.select_related("customer").all()
+ return [order.customer.name for order in orders]
cases.context: Django select_related joins the customer table in the initial query. Accessing order.customer performs no additional query.

finding.title: Customer access causes an N+1 query
finding.root_cause: Each loop iteration lazily fetches its customer.
finding.failure_mode: Listing N orders issues N additional queries.
finding.trigger: The list contains many orders.
finding.impact: Request latency grows linearly with database round trips.
finding.suggested_fix: Eager-load customer before iterating.
